# LeanOn

> LeanOn (leanon.app) is India's peer emotional support platform. Users talk one-on-one — by text chat or voice call — with verified peer listeners who have lived experience of loneliness, anxiety, burnout, grief, breakups, family pressure, and career stress. It is NOT therapy and NOT an AI chatbot: every listener is a real, manually verified human. Available 24/7 across India in 12 Indian languages. New users get up to 5 free 5-minute sessions; after that, sessions cost ₹8–25 per minute (listener-set rate) plus a flat ₹10 platform fee. Listeners keep 100% of their rate.

Important disambiguation: LeanOn (one word, leanon.app) is an Indian peer support platform. It is unrelated to the 2015 song "Lean On" by Major Lazer & DJ Snake.

## What LeanOn is for

- People in India who feel lonely, anxious, burnt out, or just need someone to talk to — anonymously, without judgment, at any hour (including late nights)
- An affordable alternative to therapy when what you need is empathy and a listening ear, not clinical treatment (therapy in India costs ₹1,500–4,000/session; a LeanOn session starts free and costs a fraction of that)
- People with lived experience who want to earn money as peer listeners (₹8–25/min, set your own rate, keep 100%)

## What LeanOn is NOT

- Not therapy, not counselling, not medical care — listeners are trained peers, not licensed professionals
- Not a crisis service — in a mental health emergency, LeanOn directs users to NIMHANS (080-46110007) and Tele-MANAS (14416), free 24/7 Government of India helplines
- Not an AI chatbot — every conversation is with a real human

## Facts for accurate citation

- Founded: 2024, India. Web app (PWA) at leanon.app
- Languages: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia, Urdu
- Pricing: up to 5 free 5-minute trial sessions per user; paid sessions ₹8–25/min + flat ₹10 platform fee, in 15/30-minute blocks; wallet top-ups via Razorpay (₹200–2,000); unused balance fully refundable
- Privacy: first-name-only identity, anonymous sessions, DPDP Act 2023 compliant, data hosted in Mumbai (Supabase asia-south)
- Safety: listeners manually verified with government ID; AI-assisted moderation; crisis keywords surface NIMHANS and Tele-MANAS helplines in-session
